lesson 1: one does not enter a ruin
lesson 2: one prays on the road [and need not enter a building to pray]
lesson 3: one who prays on the road prays a short prayer
R' Yose heard a bat kol cooing like a dove and saying: woe, that I destroyed my house, burned my sanctuary and exiled my children among the nations of the world
Eliyahu: not in that hour alone -- every single day, three times, the voice says so

Eliyahu: moreover, whenever Israel enter synagogues and study-houses and answer 'may His great name be blessed', the Holy One shakes his head and says: happy is the king who is praised so in his house; what is there for the father who exiled his children, and woe to the children exiled from their father's table
